source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. The header prints only 'SCHOOL' (no school name). No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name (...-060323-150323-2023) and the icseboard.org folder. Question I 'Dictation [4]' has no written question and is not included. Marks are printed only per group: groups whose marks would be fractional per item (II, III, IV, V, VII) are kept as one entry per group; groups that divide evenly (VIII, IX, XI, XII) are split with marks from the group total. The paper jumps from IX to XI (no X printed). XII is 'any 5' of seven (10 marks), so listed marks exceed the attempted total. Literature questions (reference to context, short answers) are mapped to the nearest listed chapter, 'reading'. The Whatsapp advertisement on page 3 and the icseboard.org watermark are ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.sectionTitle: V. Rewrite the following, replacing the adjective phrase by adjectives of similar meaning.
questions.text:
Rewrite the following, replacing the adjective phrase by adjectives of similar meaning.
a) The cave [under the water] was full of coral [of great beauty].
b) The horse [with the injury] did not run the race.
extractionIssues: Marks printed only for the group; item marks would be fractional, so the group is kept as one entry
Italics marking the adjective phrases shown as [brackets]

figures.alt: The two printed sentences: a) The cave under the water was full of coral of great beauty. b) The horse with the injury did not run the race. The phrases 'under the water', 'of great beauty' and 'with the injury' are printed in italics.
